findings.message: Dale's cone level count and naming disagree across the unit. docs/semester-4/efpg-402/unit-04/topic-01.mdx:57-61 teaches five levels (Direct purposeful experiences; Contrived experiences and models; Dramatisation and demonstrations; Visual and auditory media; Verbal and text symbols). static/img/figures/efpg-402/unit-04/fig-U4-2.svg renders four bands (Direct Purposeful Experiences; Demonstrations & Working Models; Visual & Auditory Media; Verbal & Text Symbols). docs/semester-4/efpg-402/unit-04/unit-assessment.mdx:105 asks for "the four main levels" and its key at :154 names Direct, Contrived, Visual, Verbal. A candidate who answers from the taught text with five levels cannot match the 4-mark key, and the figure's second band name differs from the key. Repair: choose one canonical set and align the topic-01 prose, fig-U4-2 and the RRQ 2 key.

ERQ 3 (docs/semester-4/efpg-402/unit-04/unit-assessment.mdx:129) is required by specs/content/efpg-402/content-spec.md:268 to design a low-cost aid for a named Grade 5 concept, but it names "Closed Electric Circuits and Electrical Conductivity", which the National Curriculum of Pakistan 2022-23 places at Grade 6 (SLO S-06-B-37, Differentiate between open and closed circuits, PDF p. 56); "electrical conductivity" is not an NCP SLO (the grid names thermal conductivity at Grade 7). Repair: relabel the item to Grade 6 or substitute a Grade 5 concept such as S-05-B-16/S-05-B-17 (flow of current, circuit diagrams).

Several curriculum-grade references contradict the NCP progression grid (source-checks/ncp-science-2022-grade-check.txt). topic-03.mdx:28 says Grade 5 respiration expects diaphragm mechanics, but Grade 5 SLO S-05-A-02 excludes detailed respiratory-system knowledge and the air pathway is Grade 7 SLO S-07-A-11. topic-03.mdx:94 says Grade 5 transpiration and xylem flow, but transpiration is Grade 8 (Benchmark II) and xylem/phloem role is Grade 7 SLO S-07-A-02. topic-04.mdx:28 says Grade 8 atomic structure, but atomic structure is Grade 7 SLO S-07-B-01 (chemical bonds are Grade 8). topic-04.mdx:94 says Grade 6 changes of state, but the Grade 5 Benchmark VII covers conditions that cause matter to change state. unit-assessment.mdx:125 calls sound transmission and waves a Grade 8 topic, but sound characteristics and transmission are Grade 5 SLOs S-05-B-11/12 and waves are the Grade 8 benchmark. Repair: align every grade reference with the NCP progression grid.
